//: Type-check configuration for the automated browser lane.
Separate from tsconfig.json on purpose. The main configuration covers the
shipped bundle; the e2e sources are Node-side test code that must never end
up in it, and `include: ["src", ...]` is what keeps that true. Without this
second project the e2e sources would have no type coverage at all — the
exact 'a build is not a type-check' mistake the stack rules name.
The same strictness applies: this code narrows tool results and API bodies
that arrive as `unknown`, which is where the strict flags earn their keep.
